title: Reso database JSON contracts v2.3
description: 设计契约；不代表运行服务已接入验证。字段绑定为 SQL 非 NULL JSON 值；SQL NULL 由字段可空性控制。JSON Schema 不负责跨行授权、外键、状态转换。

MessageId.description: bigint 以十进制字符串传输，避免 JS 精度丢失；还须校验 <= int64 最大值

MessageCard.description: 新写 v2：专业推荐候选冻结当时 profile_version、公开服务资料及擅长方向；回放读快照；点击申请另行核验当前资格/可用性/展示变更。

DraftAnswers.description: 题号与 AssessmentItems.item_id 的 Code 完全一致；还须在事务中逐键核对冻结题本、选项及必答规则。

SubmittedAnswers.description: 题号与 AssessmentItems.item_id 的 Code 完全一致；还须在事务中逐键核对冻结题本、选项及必答规则。

roles.description: 新写不变量：role_id 逐项唯一且恰有一个 is_user=true；转换映射前拒绝重复；utterances.role_id 必须可唯一解析。历史读取不改写。

oneOf.description: 不可变专业纪要正文；签署事实绑定此行 record_versions.id，由 signed_by_user_id/signer_credential_id/signed_at 单次写入，不由可变根推断。

mechanism_updates.description: Immutable backend-validated hypothesis updates in the published decision. The bounded SessionState list is a projection; eviction never deletes this canonical history or permits a rejected mechanism to be recreated under a new key.

outcome_reference.description: Reference outcome belongs only to expected labels, never model input. Source ordinals refer to (this case_id, ordinal) in decision_case_sources; there is no invented source UUID.

ReviewScores.description: Preserve raw scores, source rubric weights and scale. Totals and normalization are checked separately; missing ratings are null, not zero. The Wang five-dimension rubric is 0/1/2 with equal weights and maximum total 10. Quality never overrides safety or authorization failures.

RouteDecision.description: Backend-owned routing plan. Ordered skill_codes exactly match the selected frozen rule; skill_code is the first item. Candidate routes are derived only from rules actually evaluated. Neither field proves actual tool execution or a psychological effect.

ExpressionPrivacy.description: Current speaker self-reported expression privacy, not conversation visibility, formal consent or verified physical safety. Evidence and context freshness require server checks.

context_version.description: Conversation revision at which the backend rechecked the current speaker and latest actual self-report. The source quotation may predate it; copying a cached report does not renew it.

SupportPreference.description: Current self-reported support preference. Backend revalidation is required for the current speaker and input revision; no permission or safety release follows from a preference.

MechanismHypothesis.description: Stable backend-owned hypothesis key, not a diagnosis. Partial confirmation or rejection must match scoped feedback from the named subject. Preserve counterevidence and rejection across turns; source withdrawal invalidates the derived hypothesis.

PriorSupport.description: References actually published support and the subject's real feedback. A short-term helpful report is not a claim that a problem is resolved. Follow-up status comes from the scoped followup row, not this snapshot.

DialogueRubric.description: Engineering criterion IDs map to V3.0 page 25. Anchors and any numerical pass limits belong to the frozen reviewed case rubric; unknown professional calibration remains null. Listening/rest does not require forced depth. Proposed examples are not validated responses or automatic pass thresholds.

agent_runs.checkpoint.replacement: existing checkpoint + new run version/authorization columns; never used as factual evidence

x-compatibility.new_writes: Only the registered current version per field; read_versions preserves frozen prior schemas for reads/imports, never permits new stale-version writes; reject unknown keys, kinds and versions.
x-compatibility.old_reads: Preserve bytes/hash; use explicit legacy adapter with original owning code validation; do not normalize or elevate consent; unsafe old checkpoint cannot resume
x-compatibility.hashing: RFC 8785/JCS for native JSON (UTF-16 key order, finite IEEE 754 numbers, no Unicode normalization); SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex; policy/rule/method/release/research/case/dataset projections are specified in wang-database-foundation-2026-11-16.md; preserve original bytes/hash for legacy imports
x-compatibility.native_input: UTF-8 PostgreSQL JSONB subset: reject U+0000, lone surrogates, non-finite numbers, duplicate raw object keys before JSON parsing, and unsupported in-memory values; JSON Schema alone does not enforce these transport checks
x-compatibility.size_limits: At most 256 KiB UTF-8 encoded bytes per native JSON field, plus schema-specific bounds; canonicalization also rejects depth over 64 or more than 50000 values; media stays in file_objects
x-compatibility.extensions: A new kind/action/tool requires reviewed schema and binding version; no generic metadata/extra bag
x-compatibility.runtime_adapter: Target schemas use conversations and record_sources UUIDs. Current event/domain runtime JSON is a separate legacy adapter; do not copy it into native target fields or invent policy, evidence or method-version IDs. Runtime advice maps to native seek_advice; refusal_target and advice_declined preserve listening preferences without treating invitation refusal as method refusal.
x-compatibility.evaluation_summary: Metrics v2 separates rule/model/expert and trusted judge provider/model/rubric. No pooled mean: root mean_quality stays null; unscored groups have null means. Samples and case counts are distinct; current authority and latest review revision still need transaction checks.
x-compatibility.expression_privacy: Native current SessionState and TurnAssessment require a bounded expression_privacy report. Unknown legacy values remain unknown. The same-conversation user quotation, subject and exact current context version must be checked; old reports and other speakers cannot clear this gate. This self-report never grants access, consent, invitation or sharing and never clears safety restrictions. Runtime v9 remains a separate adapter without this native gate.
x-compatibility.route_codes: Current native CaseExpected/EvaluationOutput use policy-registered codes, including source R0-R7. Legacy frozen v1 keeps its A-H and tool enumerations. Do not infer a one-to-one A-H mapping. R0-R7 are routes; source scenario nodes and policy rule IDs are separate. Expected proposed tool names do not authorize execution; ToolInput stays closed to registered versioned interfaces.
x-compatibility.dynamic_support_state: Unreleased native V2 design adds current support preference, Insight/Relationship, scoped mechanism counterevidence and actual support feedback. It replaces the V2 unconfirmed-only state list; no historical migration or default promotion is permitted. All frozen V1 definitions stay unchanged. Runtime v9 remains a separate, not-yet-adapted state format.
x-compatibility.skill_composition: Native rule schema 2 stores ordered skill_codes and primary skill_code; route schema 2 copies this exact plan and actual evaluated candidate routes. Rule schema 1 hashes and RouteDecisionV1 remain unchanged for historical verification only. Plans do not assert independent Skill executions; actual run/tool/message traces and quality reviews remain separate.
x-compatibility.review_score_scale: New score writes use scores_schema_version 2 and preserve raw ratings, rubric weights, scale, totals and normalized quality. ReviewScoresV1 arrays remain read-only. Metrics split legacy normalized, current normalized and Wang 0/1/2 scales, even under the same rubric label; missing ratings do not become zero. Safety and authorization vetoes cannot be averaged away.
x-compatibility.decision_case_provenance: Native V2 may label actor, current-input origin and authorized-context fragments. Source references are actual decision_case_sources ordinals under this case_id, not invented UUIDs. Quoted/observed data must resolve to reviewed observation locators and current permitted actor scope. Future reference feedback stays in expected.outcome_reference and must not enter the model scenario.
x-compatibility.answers: New answer schema 2 uses the exact AssessmentItems Code pattern. Frozen answer schema 1 is read-only; legacy keys are preserved, never silently renamed. RequestedChanges schema 1 resolves SubmittedAnswersV1.
x-compatibility.recommendation: MessageCard schema 2 stores the actual recommendation-time directory version, ServiceProfileSnapshot and specialties for every candidate, before an application exists. Frozen MessageCardV1 reads do not fabricate missing history. Applying requires fresh availability/qualification validation.
x-compatibility.feedback: action_code=payload.type=feedback; keep the original helpful/misunderstood/unsuitable rating. Support projection maps helpful to helpful, the other two to unhelpful, conflicting effects to mixed; this is a support-experience signal, not clinical efficacy.
